issues.issue: Should the Court reconsider its March 12, 2024 Judgment relief under Rule 397(1)(b) to declare suspensions no longer in effect and confirm Chief Heron as acting Chief?
issues.applicant_position: Chief Heron requests reconsideration to declare suspensions no longer in effect and confirm her as acting Chief.
issues.respondent_position: SRFN argues Rule 397 exceptions are narrow; no clerical error exists; motion attempts to amend pleadings and add relief not pleaded.
issues.result_text: Applicant's motion for reconsideration under Rule 397(1)(b) is dismissed; no overlooked matters or clerical errors found.

issues.issue: Should solicitor-client costs be awarded to Chief Heron for alleged abuse of process by SRFN in continuing suspensions despite Court judgment?
issues.applicant_position: SRFN's conduct is abuse of process; Chief Heron entitled to full solicitor-client costs.
issues.respondent_position: SRFN denies misuse of Court procedures; costs, if any, should be awarded to SRFN against Chief Heron.
issues.result_text: Court exercises discretion to not award costs; each party bears own costs.
